notes.title: Cave Digger 2: Dig harder! store page is up!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/f296512af8b8bae9efe394d0830d60e0286cafcc.png[/img]

The development has progressed to the point that we were able to publish the store "coming soon" page for our Digger sequel. However the time of the release is still unknown as there is a lot of things to do. You can see some early screenshots from the game in the store page, but some visual aspects will still change and we will be adding new screens and videos to the store page as we get more things ready!

Many of the basic mining mechanics are starting to look pretty good, as does the multiplayer and level generation. 

The artist have been killing it with the 3D models and concept art lately and we've published many of these on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cavedigger]discord server[/url] and social media channels. 

Also shoutout to our audio designer / composer for creating these tunes:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L7ypcVDanlM&ab_channel=VRKiwi]Main Theme[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xcLe9L6vIm4&ab_channel=VRKiwi]Exploration theme[/url]

You can follow our devblog at [url=https://vrkiwi.org/development-log/]https://vrkiwi.org/development-log/[/url] to find out more details about what we're working on each week. 


To help us out, wishlist the game and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cavedigger]discord server[/url]. We will arrange some design competitions and giveaways in the future.

notes.title: We're publishing Crystal Raiders VR - Try the demo during Steam Festival!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37171444/15f2b33e6a481d7cf315111f6b83d76695f66f14.jpg[/img]


Grab your weapon and prepare for the first Crystal Raid during the Steam game festival, starting Feb 3rd! Crystal Raiders VR will be available until Feb 9th, and during that time you'll be able to hear more about our plans for this year and see the developer broadcast. Wishlist and follow the game here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270380/Crystal_Raiders_VR/

VRKiwi, a VR game publisher based in Oulu, Finland, will be publishing Crystal Raiders VR by Nieko. Combining the versatile team of skilled game developers from Nieko and the expertise of marketing and publishing from VRKiwi, we aim to make Crystal Raiders the best possible version of it.

We plan to release the game in 2021, but the details of our schedule remain to be seen. The game is in a rather good state, and we're currently working on smoothing out the experience. Crystal Raiders will be taking part in the steam game festival in 2021, so you all should be able to try and test the game. We hope to gather some valuable feedback from our community.

For now, follow and wishlist the game from the link above and join our [url=https://discord.gg/2DY2s6T]discord server[/url] to keep yourselves in the loop!

Happy raiding!

notes.title: Cave Digger released on XBox and Nintendo Switch (EU)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37171444/355482e98bb3b5db42428bd5e7b21fe7e48d84b0.jpg[/img]

News from the other-than-Steam frontiers!

A while ago Cave Digger was released on XBox and is now available on both One and Series X|S. You can purchase it [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/Cave-Digger/9NC0FQML41QL?activetab=pivot:overviewtab]from the Microsoft store[/url].

Arguably even more interestingly, the diggers will also be able to mine gems and artifacts where ever they are, as long as they keep their Nintendo Switch with them. At least in the EU region now. The NA release for Switch will be later this month so keep your pickaxes erected if you're from the North-America.

[url=https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Cave-Digger-1893009.html]EU Switcherino can be purchased here[/url].

This has been the... uh.. frontier news cast.

notes.title: Cave Digger 2: Dig harder! development begins
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37171444/da93a9558d332d742b933719cdfd14483aae9218.png[/img]

Great news from the frontier! We have discovered new weird west frontiers in the New Country and have begun the production of Cave Digger 2: Dig Harder! 

It’s all still very new and there are a lot of things to do, but from now on you will be receiving news and development updates regularly. We hope to include as many of you as possible in the process to make sure the game is gonna be awesome for both original and new diggers to come. 

CD2 will be first and foremost a VR release, and we aim to keep and improve some loved cave digger features, but also bring a bunch of new ones. More about those soon, probably in the form of some concept art to begin with.

You of course want to know when we’re planning to release this, but it’s too early to say now. What I can tell you now is that we’re planning to go early access first, probably Q2 or Q3 in 2021. Let’s see. 

The badass in the image? That’s Clayton. Clayton is a miner, but not the player. This is one of the first concept images made for the game, so the subject is bound to change. 

What would you like to see in CD2: Dig harder? Comment below or join us in discord:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/cavedigger]https://discord.com/invite/cavedigger [/url]

notes.title: Patch notes from 19th of October
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37171444/bea109533c322c6a57b5f455ae004e0514f808ea.jpg[/img]

The frontier pest control has swatted several bugs lately and this is probably one of the bigger updates since the launch of Cave Digger PC edition. Your digging, in general, shall be a smoother experience and your endings will be triggered and proceeded without inconveniences.


[list]
[*] loading time optimization
[*] texture crash fix
[*] Amulet ending fix
[*] Chaos Glove ending visual fix
[*] door handle confusion reduced
[*] fixed Endings finished counter not always updating
[*] fixed some mining chambers spawning with blocked entraces
[*] fixed trips sometimes glitching the elevator
[*] increased selection radius for easier selecting
[/list]

Oh, and by the way, we're gonna announce something heckin' interesting very soon so follow our games on Steam and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cavedigger]discord[/url] to stay on the minecart of things. 


This has been the frontier newscast, happy digging!

notes.title: Cave Digger PC Edition release date
notes.notes:
As the title suggests, we've finally published the exact release date of Cave Digger PC Edition. August 14th! 

The game is in a very stable state, and we will be spending the remaining time to adjust and fix some minor things to make the experience a wee bit smoother for you all, as well as updating the trailer finally. In the meantime, you can expect to start seeing some YouTubers and other content creators posting videos.

Our sincerest thanks go to all the beta testers and the OG fans from the VR digger who have been providing valuable feedback.

[url=discord.gg/cavedigger]Join our discord if you haven't already!
[/url]

See you in the frontier!
